But what if your commerce infrastructure was designed to operate independently of these platforms? Before you can deploy your digital store on Cloudflare Pages, you'll need to set up a GitHub account and install the Cloudflare Pages CLI. Additionally, you'll need to set up a NOWPayments account, which will handle your payment processing. Don't worry – these setup steps are straightforward and well-documented. Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

With the Sovereign Blueprint, you'll be able to deploy a payment and delivery pipeline that operates on your own terms. You'll also set up a Supabase database to store your orders and a Cloudflare R2 bucket to deliver your products. This pipeline is designed to be fully automated, with a decentralized architecture that ensures your business remains operational even when platforms fail.
